design.task_selection: within each eligible station: directed backdoor-free strict-indirect pairs first, then shortest station-local directed path, then lexical action/target; graph-only selection

decision.target_rule: training Y mean + 1 sample SD; scale is training Y sample SD
decision.action_grid_rule: training X empirical quantiles 0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9 (linear); five distinct values required

evaluation.interval: pointwise percentile 95%; shared action-loss table and common G0/action resamples across policy contrasts

stopping_and_resume: No replacement seeds or response draws after outcome review.
No overwrite of any run output.
Recommendation and response outputs remain in the external private run root.
A cap or technical failure preserves completed files and is reported as partial; it does not authorize a changed cohort.
limitations: Two station task strata share one fitted full-line DGP and one training frame; no independent environment-level inference.
G0 units are corruption draws conditional on one fitted DGP, not independent SCMs.
Reference-DAG-assisted repair, semisynthetic DRF assumptions, five-action grid, one target rule, and atomic edge-count cost condition all results.
No physical manufacturing intervention or deployment claim.
The official source is AGPL-3.0; raw source data and private model/output artifacts are not redistributed in this repository.
